chooseACompanyAnd: Choose a company and complete the guided tutorial. Click space to fly, select a target and attack. Use the minimap to navigate and return to a station to prepare your ship.
mapJumpPortalRoute: map jump portal route galaxy sector
openGalaxyToInspect: Open Galaxy to inspect sectors and set a route. Fly to a gate and press J to jump. Frontier IV connects the high sectors; the minimap marks the next gate on an active route.
attackDamageLaserRocket: attack damage laser rocket shield hull repair
lasersRocketsAndLauncher: Lasers, rockets and launcher volleys have different ranges. Shields absorb 80% of incoming damage while available; the remainder reaches the hull. Repair outside combat and watch for hostile telegraphs.
hangarShipSlotsLoadout: hangar ship slots loadout generator laser safe
equipLasersGeneratorsAnd: Equip lasers, generators and extras in the hangar. Ships have two configurations; switch between them with C. Equipment changes require a safe zone, such as a station or a safe gate.
dronesAddSlotsFor: Drones add slots for lasers or generators. Formations provide separate passive bonuses. A fleet can contain up to eight drones.
questLevelXpRewards: quest level xp rewards rank contracts
completeCampaignMissionsAnd: Complete campaign missions and contracts for rewards and experience. Your pilot gains levels and can develop research skills. PvP contracts become available at level 12.
oreMineralsCargoRefine: ore minerals cargo refine boost mining
companyGroupSquadChat: company group squad chat auction shop credits aether
joinACompanyCommunicate: Join a company, communicate in chat and form a group. Visit the shop and auction to acquire equipment; credits and Aether are separate currencies.
focusChoosingA: {story} Focus: {focus}. Choosing a company determines your starting sector and can be changed from the Pilot screen during the playtest.
riftPortalWavesAether: {key} rift portal waves aether key fragments
clanRiftPortalWaves: {key} clan rift portal waves bank squad
clanOnlyWaves: {desc} Clan only · {length} waves · {lives} lives · up to {CLAN_RIFT_MAX_PILOTS} pilots.
chooseACompanyTo: Choose a company to establish your home sector, then follow the short guided tutorial: a little lore, flying and your first fight. Every screen then explains itself in a quick guide the first time you open it. You can skip the tutorial and replay it, guides included, from Settings.
clickAPointIn: Click a point in space or on the minimap to fly there. Select an alien, then click it again or press Space to open fire. Tardi and Shard do not attack first, making them useful first targets.
missionsRewardExperienceAnd: Missions reward experience and currencies. Return to a station or another safe zone to change your equipment, and check your ammunition before leaving.
openTheGalaxyWindow: Open the Galaxy window with M to inspect the sectors and the gates that connect them. The minimap shows your surroundings and can also be used to set a flight destination.
selectADestinationIn: Select a destination in the Galaxy and set a route. The next gate is marked on the minimap and in space. Frontier IV is the central connection to the high sectors and the Abyss route.
flyCloseToA: Fly close to a gate and press J. The gate charges before the jump; once charging has begun, it continues even if you move out of range.
selectAnAlienAnd: Select an alien and click it again or press Space to begin firing. Select laser ammunition on the hotbar; each equipped laser consumes ammunition. Rockets and launcher volleys are separate weapons with their own ranges.
whileShieldPointsRemain: While shield points remain, up to 80% of incoming damage is absorbed by the shield and the rest reaches the hull. Once the shield is depleted, damage goes to the hull. At zero hull the ship is destroyed.
watchHostileAttacksAnd: Watch hostile attacks and move to avoid their telegraphed abilities. Choose targets appropriate to your equipment, keep ammunition in reserve and repair outside combat before engaging again.
theEquipmentWindowShows: The Equipment window shows ship slots and your inventory. Lasers occupy laser slots, shield cells and engines use generator slots, and modules such as repair or cloak use extra slots. Drones can add more laser or generator slots. Right-click an item to repair or sell it.
eachShipHasTwo: Each ship has two equipment configurations. Switch as often as you like from the Equipment window while docked at a station or safe gate. In flight, press C to switch, even in combat, with a 5-second cooldown: for example to choose between a more offensive loadout and one with more speed or shielding.
returnToASafe: Return to a safe zone, such as a station or a safe gate, before changing equipment. The SAFE ZONE indicator confirms when you are protected.
dronesExtendAShip: Drones extend a ship with slots that can hold lasers or generators. Scout drones have two slots and Seraph drones have three. A pilot can own up to eight drones.
aFormationChangesThe: A formation changes the passive bonuses of your drone fleet. Compare its advantages and trade-offs in the hangar before choosing one for your current loadout.
openMissionsWithQ: Open Missions with Q to accept objectives and track progress. Campaign missions introduce activities across the galaxy; contracts offer additional objectives and rewards. Up to five missions can be active at once.
experienceAdvancesYourPilot: Experience advances your pilot level. Research uses data cores to improve abilities such as damage, armor, shields and speed. PvP contracts become available from level 12.
clickMineralsOrCargo: Click minerals or cargo in space to approach and collect them. Collection takes time and is interrupted by movement. Your cargo has limited capacity, so visit the refinery when it fills up.
theRefineryCombinesLowerTier: The refinery combines lower-tier minerals into higher-tier materials. Recipes list the ingredients and their quantities. Browse the Resources topic for the individual recipes.
applyCompatibleMineralsTo: Apply compatible minerals to weapons or generators for temporary bonuses. Adding the same mineral extends the effect; replacing it with a different mineral discards the remaining duration or charges after confirmation.
yourCompanyDeterminesYour: Your company determines your starting sector and can be changed from the Pilot screen during the playtest. Groups can contain up to eight pilots from any company. Use chat and the group window to coordinate.
eligibleGroupMembersShare: Eligible group members share base alien rewards when they are alive, nearby, in the same sector and have contributed damage recently. Mission progress is granted to eligible participants.
creditsAndAetherAre: Credits and Aether are separate currencies. Browse the shop for ships, equipment and ammunition, or visit the auction to bid on available items. Prices and availability are shown before an action is confirmed.
aggressiveAndCanAttack: aggressive and can attack nearby pilots without being provoked
notAggressiveAndDoes: not aggressive and does not attack first
itHasHullAnd: It has {hull} hull and {shield} shield, with {damage} base damage. Defeating it awards {xp} XP and {credits} credits before applicable sharing or bonuses.
noSectorSpawnsAre: No sector spawns are currently listed for this species.
theHullProvidesLaser: The hull provides {laserSlots} laser slots, {genSlots} generator slots and {extraSlots} extra slots. Equip lasers, shield cells, engines and modules to build the loadout that suits your flight.
aStationIsPresent: A station is present in this sector.
thereIsNoStation: There is no station in this sector.
onlyClansCanEnter: Only clans can enter it. A Leader or an Officer opens it from Menu → Clan → Bank for {key} credits of the clan bank; it cannot be probed with rift keys or Aether.
thePortalAppearsIn: The portal appears in the company X-1 sector for every member who joined at least 24 hours ago. One arena per clan, up to {CLAN_RIFT_MAX_PILOTS} pilots; progress is saved on the clan.
openRiftsOPick: Open Rifts (O), pick how many probes and press Probe. Rift keys are spent first, automatically; once they run out each probe costs {RIFT_PROBE_COST} Aether, only if you allow it. Each probe has a {partChance}% chance to yield a fragment (one is guaranteed after {RIFT_PITY} probes without one); probes aimed at the other rifts can also drop its fragments at half that chance, and every probe returns a side reward: ammo, credits, Aether, data cores or rift keys. {parts} fragments open the rift.
anOpenRiftPlaces: An open rift places a portal in your company X-1 sector. Only you can see and use it, except the Abyssal Crown, which your squad can join. The arena is private; leaving keeps the wave you reached.
